dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: Hey Ainur! How was your Monday yesterday?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Don't ask, Daniyal. It was a complete disaster. How was yours?

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: Mine was actually great! The weather was sunny and warm all day.

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: The weather here was awful — cold, rainy, and so windy. I was soaking wet!

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: Oh no! Where were you in the morning? Were you on time for your lecture?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: No — I was almost ten minutes late! My alarm clock was broken.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: That's awful. Was the professor angry with you?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: She was not happy at all. Her face was very stern. I was so embarrassed.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: Were your friends with you at lunch at least?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: No — they were all busy. I was alone. The cafeteria was crowded and the soup was cold.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: That sounds really hard. Were you in the library in the afternoon?

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Yes, for three whole hours. I was exhausted but I was determined to finish my notes.

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: You're amazing. My evening was the best part — I was at the Debate Club and our team was the winner!

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Wow, congratulations! Were you nervous before the debate?

dialogue.speaker: Daniyal
dialogue.text: I was very nervous at first, but once I started speaking, I was fine.

dialogue.speaker: Ainur
dialogue.text: Yesterday was so different for us! But today is a new day — I'm ready!
